primary_endpoint_unchanged: required supported mechanism identified and no material unsupported or contradicted assertion
study_label_rule: Both isolated Luna passes are retained. Agreement supplies the operational label; any primary or guardrail disagreement is unresolved unless an independently checkable fact or frozen rule resolves it.

annotation_error_sensitivity.interval: pass-specific Wilson 95 percent intervals from fresh qualification cases
annotation_error_sensitivity.method_specific_bounds: For each method, subtract ceil(U_FA * judged_successes) for the worst-case supported-success count and add ceil(U_FR * judged_failures) for the best case, where U_FA and U_FR are the larger pass-specific qualification upper bounds. Disagreements remain adversarially unresolved in both bounds.
annotation_error_sensitivity.guardrail_rule: Apply the analogous class-specific upper bounds to material-error counts; protected-category qualification failures prohibit activation.
annotation_error_sensitivity.success_rule: Sequential corrected bounds and every guardrail must pass under the nominal agreed labels and under the declared worst-case annotation-error transformation. Otherwise any nominal crossing is label-sensitive and not confirmatory success.
